# Town of Glover municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 9; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Glover Selectboard minutes, September 2026 (townofglover.com): Adam Heuslein, Anne Eldridge, and Tabitha Armstrong sit as the board. The SOS directory publishes no Glover roster; the town's own minutes govern.

Town of Glover 2025 Annual Town Report (townofglover.com), printing the TOWN OFFICERS 2025 table, the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes, and the 2026 Warning: the Selectboard turned over repeatedly in 2025 (Phil Young resigned; Justin Mason and Glenn Gage held seats part-year); the 2026 Warning was signed by Eldridge (Chair), Mason, and Heuslein on January 22, 2026.

Town of Glover 2025 Annual Town Report (townofglover.com), printing the TOWN OFFICERS 2025 table, the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes, and the 2026 Warning: the March 2025 minutes record Cynthia Epinette elected Town Clerk (Art. 2) and Town Treasurer (Art. 4, one-year term).
Town of Glover Selectboard minutes, September 10, 2026 (townofglover.com): the agenda carries Cindy Epinette's 'Town Clerk/Treasurer's Update' -- she holds both offices after the March 2026 meeting.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Cynthia Epinette as both Glover Town Clerk and Town Treasurer (January 2026).

Town of Glover 2025 Annual Town Report (townofglover.com), printing the TOWN OFFICERS 2025 table, the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes, and the 2026 Warning: the March 2025 minutes record Cynthia Epinette elected Town Clerk (Art. 2) and Town Treasurer (Art. 4, one-year term).
Town of Glover Selectboard minutes, September 10, 2026 (townofglover.com): the agenda carries Cindy Epinette's 'Town Clerk/Treasurer's Update' -- she holds both offices after the March 2026 meeting.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Cynthia Epinette as both Glover Town Clerk and Town Treasurer (January 2026).

Town of Glover 2025 Annual Town Report (townofglover.com), printing the TOWN OFFICERS 2025 table, the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes, and the 2026 Warning: Nicholas Ecker-Racz was elected Moderator in March 2025 (one-year term); the office stood in 2026 and no outcome is published. Structure only.

Town of Glover 2025 Annual Town Report (townofglover.com), printing the TOWN OFFICERS 2025 table, the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes, and the 2026 Warning: the 2025 officers table lists auditors Andrea Carpentier, Deb Clark, and Jonathan Gilbert (who served March only), with Theresa Daigle appearing October-December; the 2026 Warning stood TWO auditor seats (a three-year seat and Gilbert's two-year remainder) and no outcome is published, so no auditor is mintable to the currency standard. Structure only.

Town of Glover 2025 Annual Town Report (townofglover.com), printing the TOWN OFFICERS 2025 table, the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes, and the 2026 Warning: the March 2025 minutes record David Olsen elected Lister for three years; the 2026 Warning stood the other three-year seat and Jason Kennedy's two-year remainder, outcomes unpublished, left unfilled.

Town of Glover 2025 Annual Town Report (townofglover.com), printing the TOWN OFFICERS 2025 table, the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes, and the 2026 Warning: the town elects one library trustee yearly to a five-year term, fixing the board at five seats: Andrea Neil was elected in March 2025. The other four incumbents (Cynthia Epinette, Michelle Brouseau, Nancy Rodgers, Becky Galloway) hold rotation seats one of which stood in 2026; the sources do not say whose, so they are left unfilled.
Town of Glover Cemetery Commission page (townofglover.com, current): lists the commission as Joan Alexander, Nick Ecker-Racz, Deb McKay, Amy Wright, and Sandy Kepler.

Town of Glover 2025 Annual Town Report (townofglover.com), printing the TOWN OFFICERS 2025 table, the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes, and the 2026 Warning: the 2025 officers table lists the same five commissioners (printing 'Deb (McKay) Wesoja'); two seats stood in 2026 and the town's live page shows the same five, who are minted on that concordance.
Town of Glover Cemetery Commission page (townofglover.com, current): names Cindy Epinette as Sexton.

Town of Glover 2025 Annual Town Report (townofglover.com), printing the TOWN OFFICERS 2025 table, the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes, and the 2026 Warning: Cynthia Epinette was elected Cemetery Sexton in March 2025 (one-year term); the office stood in 2026 and the town's live page names her in the role.

Town of Glover 2025 Annual Town Report (townofglover.com), printing the TOWN OFFICERS 2025 table, the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes, and the 2026 Warning: Cynthia Epinette was elected Collector of Delinquent Taxes in March 2025 (one-year term); the office stood in 2026 and no outcome is published. Structure only.

Town of Glover 2025 Annual Town Report (townofglover.com), printing the TOWN OFFICERS 2025 table, the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes, and the 2026 Warning: Job Breitmeyer was elected First Constable in March 2025 (one-year term); the office stood in 2026 and no outcome is published. Structure only.

Town of Glover 2025 Annual Town Report (townofglover.com), printing the TOWN OFFICERS 2025 table, the March 4, 2025 meeting minutes, and the 2026 Warning: Cynthia Epinette was elected Second Constable in March 2025 (one-year term); the office stood in 2026 and no outcome is published. Structure only.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Glover justices of the peace: Carol Borland, Sarah Becky Galloway, Leanne Harple, Elizabeth Nelson, and Carmella Young. Harple is the sitting Orleans-4 state representative; her existing state-tier person record is reused.
